svg.title: Engineered and learned mechanism tracks
svg.desc: Research architecture by Arnav123-s. Both tracks require independent validation.
svg.text: Two different claims require two different experiments
fixed update laws and component contracts
model learns task pathways within them
test whether that supplied mechanism helps
select, compose, then learn update rules
test transfer to independent task sequences
types, correctness, retention, cost, versioned promotion
no unreviewed change to the acceptance contract
Learning to use a supplied rule is different from learning to construct or improve that rule.
